body.title: ReviewJob REDUCE: obligation keys, capped merge levels, context-only calls
body.summary: REDUCE keys initialised from every obligation before MAP; keys adjudicated in packed calls (a key with no notes too); a key whose notes do not fit is merged level by level into capped notes under short ids with provenance kept in the job; context-only calls when there are no symbols; merge answers over their cap or naming unknown note ids rejected.
acceptanceChecks: Every obligation reaches adjudication, including one with no notes and every one when there are no symbols.
A key whose symbolIds alone exceed the budget is merged under note ids, adjudicated in one call and its findings expanded to the real symbols; the job terminates.
A merge answer over its cap or naming unknown note ids is rejected.
